description: This file defines a utility enum 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore' for interacting with the iOS/macOS Keychain to securely store, retrieve, and delete generic password data. It provides static methods for saving and loading strings and raw data, as well as deleting keychain items, encapsulating Security framework calls.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Retrieves a stored string from the keychain for the given service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Stores a string value into the keychain for the specified service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the keychain item for the specified service and account.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves data blob from the keychain for given service and account.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Internal method that saves data blob into the keychain for given service and account.

methods.name: baseQuery
methods.description: Constructs the base query dictionary used for keychain operations with service and account parameters.
